428 likes, 25 comments - gardensofsanti on August 7, 2026: "ONLINE STUDIO //

With our Monthly Membership, you’ll get access to:
🩵 Community Live Classes
🌊 New flows added regularly
💌 A WhatsApp practice community for support, accountability & connection

If you’ve been curious about my yoga journey, my Vinyasa style, or you’re looking to establish a strong, consistent practice for yourself, come join in 🧜🏻‍♀️✨

My classes are a blend of strength & stretch, with a strong focus on building solid foundations so you can move with confidence, awareness, and ease. Whether you’re just beginning or have been practicing for years, all levels are welcome 💌

A space to move anytime, anywhere 🌀 

Join me inside The Flow Space. I’d love to support you on your yoga journey, help you deepen your practice, and of course, embrace the Shakti vibes together 🐍🦋

Link in bio to join. 🔗

Feel free to DM me if you have any questions 🫶🏻

#OnlineStudio #vinyasaonline #yogaonline #santi #OnlineYogaStudio •".
